name: Apocalypse ~DEUS EX MACHINA~
source:
A basement colony "Agnoshia". People living there are controlled by the machine "Arcon". Rishe's father is a scientist and his will says there is something sleeping in "Taltaros". She heads for it and finds Ash, being cold slept, and resuscitates him. "Arcon" attacks Ash but he beats it easily.... From its debris, an image appears. It says her name is Sakura and tells them to come to the top floor of "Agnoshia". Ash and Rishe decide to go there....

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/5312]Himeya Shop[/url]]

Gameplay of Apocalypse -Deus Ex Machina- consists of adventure sequences and top-down 2D shooter.
translation:
地下殖民地‘阿格诺西亚’的居民受机器‘阿尔孔’控制。莉榭的父亲是一名科学家，他在遗嘱中写道，‘塔尔塔罗斯’沉睡着某种事物。莉榭前往那里，发现处于冷冻睡眠中的阿什，并将他唤醒。阿尔孔袭击阿什，却被他轻易击败……机器残骸中浮现出一段影像。影像中的少女自称樱，要求两人前往阿格诺西亚的最上层。阿什与莉榭决定动身……

[摘自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/5312]Himeya Shop[/url]]

《Apocalypse -Deus Ex Machina-》的玩法由冒险部分与俯视视角2D射击部分组成。
